column1: # Python package versions that shipped malware. One line each, tab separated.
#   name      the package as its .dist-info folder spells it in site-packages (litellm-1.107.0.dist-info)
#   version   the exact version (every version, *, is not supported)
#   incident  an id from data/incidents.tsv, whose level must be act
# Each line is looked for as a .dist-info folder in every Python environment found and as a
# name-version entry in uv's cache. Section 5 shows one row per incident, named as incidents.tsv names it.
